provenance.paper: De Raedt, L., Kimmig, A., & Toivonen, H. (2007). ProbLog: a probabilistic Prolog and its application in link discovery.
provenance.citation: De Raedt, L., Kimmig, A., & Toivonen, H. (2007). Proceedings of IJCAI 2007, 2468-2473.
provenance.locus: Section 2: success probability P_s(q) = Σ over subprograms L ⊆ L_T where L ∪ BK ⊨ q of Π p_i Π (1-p_i) — the distribution semantics evaluated here by exact possible-worlds enumeration.
provenance.notes: Three independent probabilistic causes of wet (0.2::rain, 0.2::sprinkler, 0.3::hose) with wet :- rain / wet :- sprinkler / wet :- hose. Noisy-or closed form: P(wet) = 1 - (1-0.2)(1-0.2)(1-0.3) = 1 - 0.448 = 0.552 exactly, the PRD-mandated oracle value, asserted to 1e-6.

input.intent: compute the exact success probability of wet
